sourceRefs.locator: ARTEM 4504, Archives nationales K 1 no. 5, transmission, place, regest and ll. 1–3. Address to the duke, the domesticus Gaganricus and the agents, the estate and its former owners. The dated header gives 15 March 633.
ARTEM 4507, Archives nationales AE II 3 (K 1 no. 9), regest and ll. 1–4. Petition, brothers, inherited property and Rouergue. Place of issue unidentified. This edition gives 637.
IV.79, pp. 66–67, including n. 1. Illness at Épinay, Aega, Nanthild, Clovis and burial at Saint-Denis. Wallace-Hadrill follows Courtois in dating the death to 638.
ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.

summary.de: Der König bestätigte Erbteilungen und förderte die Basilika von Saint-Denis. Dort ließ ihn seine Familie beisetzen.
summary.en: The king confirmed divisions of family property and supported the basilica of Saint-Denis, where he was buried.
